criteria.criterion: The helper enumerates every live origin head/tag at run time without a hardcoded count. Tier: temporary real Git remotes.
The manifest collapses annotated-tag `^{}` lines while retaining exact direct and peeled OIDs. Tier: temporary real Git remotes.
Every enumerated commit ref receives exactly one old-tip relationship. Tier: real Git fixtures for same, ancestor, descendant, diverged, and unrelated histories.
A non-commit ref is recorded without an ancestry command on that object. Tier: real Git remote with a blob ref.
Partial/promisor clone refusal exits nonzero before creating refs or artifacts and names a fresh-unfiltered-clone remedy. Tier: CLI integration.
Any output destination inside a registered worktree or Git directory is refused. Tier: real worktree integration parameterized for bundle and manifest.
Any pre-existing output artifact is not overwritten. Tier: CLI integration parameterized for bundle and manifest.
The bundle named-ref map exactly matches the expected old-tip plus requested pin-tip OIDs. Tier: real Git bundle integration.
`git bundle verify` succeeds for the completed bundle. Tier: real Git bundle integration.
Bundle restore reproduces the full expected old-tip plus pin-tip OID map. Tier: real Git restore integration.
A recording Git wrapper observes no push or remote-delete invocation. Tier: CLI integration.
Origin heads/tags output is byte-identical before and after success. Tier: real Git comparison.
A caught verification failure leaves no incomplete artifact or current-run helper ref. Tier: fault-injected real-repository integration.
A pre-existing helper ref causes a nonzero fresh-clone-remedy result without deleting that ref. Tier: real Git ref integration.
Retrying from a fresh clone after simulated abnormal termination succeeds with current requested OIDs. Tier: killed-process integration.
